## What changed?

Describe the change clearly.

## Why?

What problem does this solve or what does it improve?

## How was it tested?

List the exact checks you performed.

## Screenshots / recordings

Add these when the change affects gameplay, visuals, UI, or controls.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and does not include unrelated rewrites
- [ ] I tested the relevant gameplay path locally
- [ ] I checked for obvious console errors
- [ ] I did not add third-party assets without documenting their source and usage rights
- [ ] I updated documentation when behavior or setup changed
